findings.message: The workspace path is hard-coded without a matching workspaceMount. VS Code's default mount uses the local checkout's directory name, so cloning into any directory other than ProxmoxMCP-Plus leaves this path missing and prevents postCreateCommand from installing the project. Use the default workspace location or configure a matching mount, and make the interpreter path relative to the workspace.

The project does not define a dev extra in pyproject.toml, so installing '.[dev]' does not install pytest, pytest-asyncio, mypy, or the other development dependencies listed in requirements-dev.in. The resulting container cannot run the documented test workflow. Install requirements-dev.in explicitly or define the dev extra.
